title: Crown Overview Tools
description: Crown Overview Tools 1.0.0 for Crown of Ashes. Adds permission-gated foreign Port Travel: another player must explicitly allow entry through their port before movement or crossing risk resolves; offline owners fall back to an active GM. Includes dangerous army Port Crossing, automatic character Wound updates from dangerous crossings, the v0.6.34 Market rebalance, demolition-income fix, military upkeep rebalance, trade-good rebalance, and 5/15/30 Gold construction costs.
